overall_goal: Prepare a pan with oil and crack eggs into a jug with milk and pepper

goals.description: Prepare the measuring jug and retrieve the first batch of eggs
goals.rationale: The person sets up the measuring jug on the counter and takes the first two eggs out of the carton.

goals.description: Wash the first batch of eggs
goals.rationale: The person washes the first two eggs under the tap and shakes off the excess water.

goals.description: Crack the first batch of eggs into the measuring jug
goals.rationale: The person cracks the first two eggs into the measuring jug and discards the shells.

goals.description: Retrieve and wash the second batch of eggs
goals.rationale: The person retrieves two more eggs from a different carton and washes them.

goals.description: Crack the second batch of eggs into the measuring jug
goals.rationale: The person cracks the second pair of eggs into the measuring jug and disposes of the shells.

goals.description: Prepare a pan and add oil to it
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a pan, places it on the stove, and pours olive oil into it.

goals.description: Add milk and pepper to the eggs
goals.rationale: The person adds milk and grinds pepper into the egg mixture.
